svg.title: FIG-08 Predicate wait 与外部 shutdown 责任 通知只提示重查；等待本身不推进硬件 FIG-08 Predicate wait and external shutdown a notification is a hint, not hardware progress
svg.desc: nx_wait_until：Task / 单 waiter nx_wait_until: task, one waiter; ready(context) 权威谓词 ready(context): authoritative predicate; port.arm() 捕获 sequence port.arm(): capture notification sequence; 再次 ready(context) ready(context): recheck after arm; port.wait(sequence, absolute deadline) 后端检查 sequence / deadline backend checks sequence / absolute deadline; wait error / TIMEOUT 后最终 ready final ready check after error / TIMEOUT; 谓词 true → SUCCESS predicate true -> SUCCESS; 谓词仍 false → 真实 port error predicate false -> actual port error; true; false; 已 arm armed; true; false; SUCCESS hint：循环重查 SUCCESS hint: repeat predicate check; error / TIMEOUT; 并发完成已可见 concurrent completion visible; 仍未完成 completion not observed; 唯一 executor：service / drain IRQ：latched facts + wake hint one executor: service / drain IRQ: latched facts and wake hint; wake(sequence) 提示 wake(sequence): hint; release publication → acquire observation; 应用拥有的退出顺序（不是 wait 隐式行为） application-owned shutdown, not implicit wait; 1 关闭 producer admission owner stop 请求已接受操作取消 1 close admission; owner stop requests cancellation; 2 保持 owner / IRQ service 与 drain producer / observer 仅 acquire 观察 SETTLED 2 keep owner / IRQ service and drain progressing producer / observer only acquire-observe SETTLED; 3 producer 借用已结清后 join 相关 observers 最终访问另需退出 3 join producer after its borrow drains related observers must finish their final access; 4 确认 owner idle 含 publication 退出 请求 owner 执行者结束并 join 4 prove owner idle including publication exit request executor to finish, then join; 5 硬件 RX / IRQ publishers quiescent detach wake，再 join 其他发布者 5 prove hardware RX / IRQ publishers quiescent detach wake, then join other publishers; 6 最后销毁 notification / queue / guard 仍运行内核保留 platform clock / Tick 6 finally destroy notification / queue / guard retain platform clock / Tick for a running kernel; drain / join / quiesce 失败：存储责任保留 外部政策决定升级；不强制释放 failed drain / join / quiesce retains storage external escalation, no forced reclaim; 不再产生新工作 no new producer work; 实际 SETTLED 与 observer 退出 actual settlement and observer exit; producer 最终访问结束 producer final access ended; owner execution 已退出 owner executor has exited; publishers 全部退出 all publishers have exited; 未排空 not drained; 未 join not joined; 仍有 publisher publisher remains active; 继续推进 keep executing
